title: Gyesera
infotainment: Rightware Kanzi digital cockpit (shared platform with Revero)
adasStandard: Karma advertises a comprehensive ADAS suite for the Gyesera consistent with the Revero platform: adaptive cruise, AEB, blind-spot monitoring, lane-keep assist, surround-view camera, parking sensors. Source: https://carbuzz.com/2026-karma-gyesera-price-release-date/
adasOptional: Data unavailable: Karma has not published a separate optional ADAS package list for the Gyesera as of May 2026.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines, expected to share the Rightware Kanzi-driven imaging stack with the Revero. Resolution not published.
sideViewCameraNotes: 360-degree surround-view camera expected standard, consistent with the Revero. No trailer-view, no single-side blind camera.
subscriptionFeatures: Data unavailable: Karma has not disclosed specific subscription SKUs for the Gyesera as of May 2026.
drmNotes: Same connected-car platform as the 3rd-gen Revero: OTA + Karma mobile app require embedded telematics; in-app vehicle-feature purchase capability inherited from the shared platform. Sources: https://audaxlabs.com/connected-car-app/
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving kill-switch hardware announced for the launch Gyesera. Karma has issued no public statement on the IIJA-driven NHTSA rulemaking expected ~2027.
knownIssues: Data unavailable: pre-production vehicle, no owner-forum signal as of May 2026.
recalls: Data unavailable: pre-production vehicle, no NHTSA recalls as of May 2026.
stateIncentives: Data unavailable: $165,000 MSRP exceeds the price caps of every major state EV rebate program.

title: Revero
infotainment: Rightware Kanzi digital cockpit, ~12 in center touchscreen + 12.3 in digital cluster
adasStandard: Karma publishes a high-content ADAS suite as standard: adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go, automatic emergency braking, blind-spot monitoring with rear cross-traffic alert, lane-departure warning + lane-keep assist, surround-view camera, parking sensors front and rear, and driver-attention monitoring. Source: https://karmaautomotive.com/revero/
adasOptional: Data unavailable: Karma does not break out optional ADAS packages separately on its public configurator; the limited 160-unit run ships with the full standard suite.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines integrated with the Rightware Kanzi digital cockpit. Resolution not published. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/rightware-kanzi-powers-the-digital-cockpit-and-infotainment-system-in-the-new-karma-revero-592762191.html
sideViewCameraNotes: 360-degree surround-view camera system standard. No Honda LaneWatch-style single-side blind camera and no trailer-view mode. Source: https://karmaautomotive.com/revero/
subscriptionFeatures: Data unavailable: Karma's connected-car app surface (Audax Labs) advertises a vehicle-feature purchase capability for MY2024+ Reveros, but Karma has not published specific feature SKUs, prices, or lapse behavior. Sources: https://audaxlabs.com/connected-car-app/
drmNotes: Vehicle drives without internet; OTA updates and the Karma mobile app (remote lock/unlock, preconditioning, charge schedule, vehicle health, AR manual) require the embedded telematics connection. Audax Labs powers an in-app vehicle-feature purchase capability for MY2024+ Reveros, though specific subscription SKUs have not been disclosed. Sources: https://audaxlabs.com/connected-car-app/, https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/rightware-kanzi-powers-the-digital-cockpit-and-infotainment-system-in-the-new-karma-revero-592762191.html
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving kill-switch hardware shipped in MY2025. Karma has made no public statement on its plan for the IIJA-driven NHTSA rulemaking expected ~2027.
knownIssues: Data unavailable: 3rd-gen Revero is too new and too low-volume (160 units global) for owner-forum signal. 2nd-gen Revero GT had reports of long parts lead times and limited service-network availability rather than mechanical defects per se. Source: https://www.theautopian.com/karma-automotive-sold-just-146-vehicles-last-year-its-ceo-told-me-thats-the-appeal/
recalls: Data unavailable: no NHTSA recalls have been issued against the 3rd-gen Revero as of May 2026.
stateIncentives: Data unavailable: at $123,100 MSRP, the Revero exceeds the price caps of major state EV rebates (CA CVRP $45,000 cap, etc.). California HOV-decal eligibility for PHEVs requires CARB certification, which Karma has historically held.
